notes: Aggregator sites were wrong where they could be checked (IJCAI 2027 listed as Jan 15, official is Jan 11; ECML-PKDD 2027 conference dates wrong), so plan only from official pages.
No relevant NeurIPS 2026 workshop is still open; Table Representation Learning last ran at ACL 2025 and the Mechanistic Interpretability workshop ran at ICML 2026.
EurIPS 2026 is not confirmed (only an ELLIS call for venue proposals); the 'AI for Tabular Data' workshop that hosted nanoTabPFN was at EurIPS 2025.
The xAI 2027 dates page looks copied from 2026 (it lists Feb 1, 2026); treat the paper deadline as not announced.
ECML-PKDD 2027 journal-track page returns 404; if it follows 2026, a first round could be around Oct 30, 2026. Check directly if interested.
ICML 2027 will be in South America and NeurIPS 2027 in Europe; exact dates and cities are not announced.
Journal-to-Conference (ICLR) requires a TMLR/JMLR paper with a J2C, Featured or Outstanding certification, published on or after Jan 1, 2025; poster only.

plans.name: Plan A: workshop first, then a main venue
plans.text: Pilot result with null models by about April 2027, a short paper at an ICML 2027 workshop (structured-data FMs or mechanistic interpretability, around late April or May), then the full paper at ICLR 2028 (around late September 2027) once RQ2/RQ3 and possibly the prior ablation are done.

plans.name: Plan B: straight to a main venue
plans.text: Complete core results (specification, localization, null models, selectivity across contexts) by early May 2027 for NeurIPS 2027; if that slips, ICLR 2028 (late September 2027) or AISTATS 2028 (early October 2027) as fallbacks.

plans.name: Plan C: IML-community route
plans.text: A methods-focused paper at xAI 2027 (likely around February 2027, if a solid pilot exists by then) or a rolling TMLR submission, which suits the feature-effects lineage (Rundel et al., Molnar et al.) and avoids deadline pressure.
